mapper.sql: id, title, summary, content, category, tags, pinned, views, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note (id, title, summary, content, category, tags, pinned, views, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{category}, #{tags}, #{pinned}, #{views}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE note SET title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, tags = #{tags}, pinned = #{pinned}, views = #{views}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE note SET views = views + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
